paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of preference modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the gradient norm of the preference model during training, as part of the RLHF workflow from reward modeling to online RLHF. The x-axis, labeled “Training Step,” spans from 0 to approximately 1300 with linear scaling and major tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis, labeled “Gradient Norm,” ranges from 0 to 800, also on a linear scale, with major ticks every 200 units. A single blue line, labeled “Gradient Norm of Preference Model” in the legend, traces the evolution of the gradient norm: it begins near 850 at step 0, drops sharply to below 50 by step 50, remains low and relatively stable until around step 550, where it briefly spikes to approximately 100, then returns to near-zero levels for the remainder of training up to step 1300. The plot includes a grid for easier reading of values.
